product_launches.description: Speedscale launched Proxymock, a free utility that snapshots realistic environments from deployed software to replay functional and regression tests, aiding AI agent-driven testing workflows.

overview_description.description: Speedscale helps Kubernetes engineering teams validate how new code will perform under production-like workload conditions. Speedscale can collect and replay API traffic, introduce chaos, and measure the golden signals of latency, throughput, saturation and errors before the code is released. Speedscale Traffic Replay is an alternative to legacy testing approaches which take days or weeks to run and do not scale well for modern architectures.

about_short_description.short_description: Speedscale allows users to stress test cloud services with real-world scenarios.

product.name: Speedscale Platform
product.description: A cloud-native platform for capturing, replaying, and analyzing production API traffic to test software changes, reproduce incidents, and validate fixes before deployment.

product.name: Proxymock
product.description: A local development and testing tool that generates service mocks from captured API traffic and replays requests against applications or dependencies.

product.name: Speedscale Load Testing
product.description: A load-testing service that applies production-shaped traffic patterns to APIs and cloud services to evaluate performance, capacity, and scalability.

product.name: Speedscale Service Virtualization
product.description: A service-virtualization capability that mocks internal, third-party, or unreliable dependencies with responses based on real API traffic.

product.name: Speedscale API Observability
product.description: An API observability capability for inspecting captured request and response payloads, performance characteristics, failures, and service dependencies.

product.name: Speedscale Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC)
product.description: A self-hosted deployment of the Speedscale capture, replay, and validation stack inside a customer’s AWS, GCP, or Azure environment.
